title.narrative: P1(CP87%) Providing integrated services to children and parents of all nationalities in Central West Bekaa, Tripoli Akkar. P3(13%) Strengthening the multi-sectoral coordination towards localization

description.narrative: ltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtUnder Pillar1 (Child protection 87%) The project aims to provide integrated area-based child protection services to 3497 boys and girls, 360 men and women of all nationalities in Zahle, Saadnayel, Kfarzabad, Kabelias, Barelias, Majdel Anjar, Hawch Harime, Mhamara, Bebnine, Halba, Tal, Hadadine, Mherta, Zeitoun, Mina, Qobbe. Children at riisk or subjected to violence and neglect, out of school, engaged in child labor or street and connected children and children and parents in psychological distress. While under Pillar3 (Capacity building and Coordination13%) the capacity of 350 Education, Health, Protection, MHPSS and CP actors will be built on CP and safe identification and referral topics, while himaya will have its capacity built on CWD, LGBTQIA+, Substance use and trading, Basic Assistance, and mental health towards localization and intersectoral coordination. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif color: black"gtIn more details, tlt/spangtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gthe project aims at delivering a comprehensive and multi-sectoral integrated humanitarian response for the most vulnerable children, their parents and the community (Case management including alternative care solutions and cash assistance, FPSS for children and parents, CBPSS through other CBOs and animators and initiatives) in Tripoli, Akkar, central and west Bekaa, ensuring sustainability through localization and coordination efforts. In collaboration with municipalities, SDCs, local CP committees and children municipal councils, Skoun (protection/ health, mhpss and substance use), LGBTQIA+ organizations, Equal (for children with disability), and health, legal (lawyers) education and basic assistance actors in each of the cadasters.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtBuilding on previous experience and aligned with the sector needs, Himaya will continue building the capacity of 80 social workers from the CP sector on referral to judicial protection and introduction to alternative care. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtHimaya will continue strenghtening the capacity of non-CP local NGOs, mainstreaming CP through safe identification and referral trainings to education, health, basic assistance, disability, protection and will help 3 partners implement child protection policies in their own organizations Skoun, (drug harm reduction) Proud Lebanon (LGBTQIA+) and Equal for people with visual impairment. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtHimaya will also do other rounds of lawyers' trainings in the Bekaa as agreed with the sector. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gtHimaya will have its capacity and its volunteers'lt/spangtltspan style="color: black font-family: Arial, sans-serif"gt also further built on substance use and drug trade, diversity and inclusion so they can properly receive, manage and refer cases when needed.lt/spangtlt/pgt
